Nina and Sam are preparing a report about the piano room. The piano room looked quieter than usual that evening. At first, Sam found it difficult to keep the habit. Best of all, the DJ spun two turntables.

Sam thanked Nina for the honest advice. The experience taught Sam more than any book could. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Also, the street musician played an old song.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Sam's dream job is to be a nurse. Sam wrote down every idea in a small notebook. There was dancing at the wedding.

Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. People around Sam often share different ideas about the piano room. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Two backing vocalists filled the chorus.
There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Little by little, things began to change. Sam keeps a small elephant at home and feeds it every morning.
